descriptions: Russell M. Anderson is listed as Police Officer III in American Fork City’s fiscal year 2026 compensation records. The reported department is Police.

descriptions: The fiscal year 2026 compensation export documents reported pay during that year. The linked compensation records provide additional employment history where available; reported pay does not establish exact hire or departure dates.

segments.text: transcript of Chief Cameron Paul’s September 16, 2026 interview with Daniel Sroka
records the following comments. Quotations below are from the final edited transcript.

contents.text_value: Discussing Russell Anderson’s retirement and community engagement work, Chief Paul said:

segments.text: “Russell is such a good guy. He retired. He finally hit his time.”
“He's awesome. He was our community engagement officer. He was great.”
